content.title: Red Lions edge a wild extra-time battle 3-2
paragraphs: Red Lions won 3-2 after extra time in a match that kept swinging until 120+1'. Fox put Red Lions ahead at 28', Gray levelled for Blue Sharks at 62', Reid restored the lead at 95', and Cruz brought Blue Sharks back at 105'. The final twist came at 113', when Bell scored an own goal into Blue Sharks' net, and that counted for Red Lions.

Red Lions had the stronger grip for most of the game. They finished with 69% possession, 85% of the territory, 27 shots to 15, 11 on target and 6 big chances, while their passing stayed sharp at 93% accuracy with 110 final-third entries. Blue Sharks were dangerous in bursts and kept answering, but they spent long spells under pressure and could not match Red Lions' control.

The turning point was the long spell after 95', when Red Lions kept pushing Blue Sharks deeper and kept creating the clearer chances. Even with Blue Sharks twice fighting back, Red Lions finished the night on top by sheer volume, pressure and persistence.

draft.title: Red Lions survive a wild extra-time finish to beat Blue Sharks 3-2
paragraphs: Red Lions won 3-2 after extra time in a match that swung back and forth all the way to 120+1'. Fox put Red Lions in front at 28', Gray levelled for Blue Sharks at 62', Reid restored the lead at 95', Cruz made it 2-2 at 105', and then Bell turned the ball into Red Lions' net at 113', which counted for Blue Sharks and settled the final score at 3-2 to Red Lions.

Red Lions controlled most of the night. Across the match they had 69% possession, 85% of the territory, and 27 shots to Blue Sharks' 15, with 11 on target and 6 big chances. The passing was crisp too, with 93% accuracy and 110 entries into the final third, while Blue Sharks were more direct and far less comfortable on the ball.

The turning point came in extra time. Blue Sharks kept finding replies, but Red Lions kept pinning them back, and the pressure told in the closing stages when Red Lions spent the last 10 minutes camped in Blue Sharks' half, with 91% of the final-third actions and 79% of possession. In the end, Red Lions won by sheer volume and territory, even if the last twist came through Bell's own goal.
